note: The one file that decides how every agent's documents, decks, workbooks and charts look. Change a value here
and every deliverable of every agent changes with it; no code is touched. The colour of a table header is
themes.<theme>.table.header (a palette token); the colour behind it is that token's value in themes.<theme>.palette.
Sizes are in points, one set per format, five roles only: a renderer that is asked for a sixth refuses.
The layout catalogue is closed: a layout is added here, deliberately, never by a caller inline.

fonts.note: the one family every deliverable is set in; it carries Thai and Latin and is embedded in every file

brand.note: what an organisation may bring: a logo, a primary colour, a typeface. Each is refused with its reason when it would make the document unreadable, and the theme's own value stays.

title.for: the first slide: what this is, for whom, when
title.refuses: a fifth line, or a title over 60 characters

section.for: a divider between parts of the deck

figure.for: one big figure a room can read, with its label and one sentence
figure.refuses: a second figure, or a sentence over 160 characters

figures.for: a row of two or three figures with their labels and changes
figures.refuses: one figure (that is a figure slide) or more than three

table.for: a table of up to ten rows; longer tables break across slides with the header repeated
table.refuses: more than seven columns, or a cell over 40 characters

chart.for: one chart with its title and a caption of up to two lines at the small size
chart.refuses: more than four series or twelve categories, two charts, or a caption over 300 characters

bullets.for: a heading and up to four points of up to two lines, with an optional lead sentence
bullets.refuses: a fifth point (the points break across slides), or a point too long for two lines even at the small size

statement.for: one paragraph that stands on its own — the summary
statement.refuses: a second paragraph, or more than 480 characters even at the small size

closing.for: the last slide: the sources with their hashes, the references, the model and the scope
closing.refuses: a fifteenth line (the lines break across slides)

cover.for: the first page: the organisation, the title, the period, the headline figures, how the report was made
cover.refuses: a fourth cover line, or a title over 60 characters

section.for: a heading and the blocks under it

table.for: a table that may run over pages with its header repeated and no row split
table.refuses: more than nine columns, or a cell over 400 characters

chart.for: a chart picture with its title, its caption and the table of its numbers, kept together
chart.refuses: more than four series or fourteen categories

prose.for: paragraphs and bullet lists, with their references listed under the block
prose.refuses: a paragraph over 2,000 characters, a list over twenty items, or an item over 400 characters

appendix.for: the appendices: two columns of small entries

face.for: the first sheet, which prints on one page: who, what, when, the balances and the verdict
face.refuses: a face longer than one printed page

table.for: a table sheet: one header row, frozen and repeated on every printed page, one page wide
table.refuses: a sheet name over 31 characters or with [ ] : * ? / \ in it, or a table still wider than a page at 67 percent after its text columns are narrowed and wrapped

notes.for: a sheet of notes and assumptions
